q_en:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the highlighted phrase in the given sentence.

He never wasted words; his style was admired for his use of very few words to express much.
q_hi:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the highlighted phrase in the given sentence.

He never wasted words; his style was admired for his use of very few words to express much.
solution:
Solution (EN):
The phrase "use of very few words to express much" refers to 'brevity'. It means concise and exact use of words in writing or speech.
1. Verbosity: Using more words than needed.
2. Eloquence: Fluent or persuasive speaking or writing.
3. Candor: The quality of being open and honest.

Solution (HI):
वाक्यांश "use of very few words to express much" (बहुत कम शब्दों में बहुत कुछ कहना) 'brevity' (संक्षिप्तता) को संदर्भित करता है।
1. Verbosity: आवश्यकता से अधिक शब्दों का प्रयोग।
2. Eloquence: सुवक्ता या वाक्पटुता।
3. Candor: स्पष्टवादिता या ईमानदारी।

Short Trick:
Brevity is related to 'Brief' (small/short).

q_en:
Select the most appropriate article to fill in the blank. If no article is needed, select 'No article required'.

My uncle is ______ honest man who always speaks the truth.
q_hi:
Select the most appropriate article to fill in the blank. If no article is needed, select 'No article required'.

My uncle is ______ honest man who always speaks the truth.
solution:
Solution (EN):
The word 'honest' begins with a silent 'h', so its pronunciation starts with a vowel sound (/αn∞st/). Therefore, the indefinite article 'an' is used before it.

Solution (HI):
'Honest' शब्द एक मूक (silent) 'h' से शुरू होता है, इसलिए इसका उच्चारण स्वर ध्वनि (/αn∞st/) से शुरू होता है। अतः इसके पहले अनिश्चित उपपद (indefinite article) 'an' का प्रयोग किया जाता है।

Short Trick:
Honest → Vowel Sound → An.

op_en: This is the more tall building in our city.
This is the most taller building in our city.
This is the tall building in our city.
This is the tallest building in our city.
op_hi: This is the more tall building in our city.
This is the most taller building in our city.
This is the tall building in our city.
This is the tallest building in our city.
q_en:
Identify the option that rectifies the given sentence to make it grammatically correct.

This is the most tallest building in our city.
q_hi:
Identify the option that rectifies the given sentence to make it grammatically correct.

This is the most tallest building in our city.
solution:
Solution (EN):
The word 'tallest' is already in the superlative degree. Using 'most' before a superlative adjective creates a double superlative error, which is grammatically incorrect. The correct sentence should simply be "This is the tallest building...".

Solution (HI):
'Tallest' शब्द पहले से ही सुपरलेटिव डिग्री (superlative degree) में है। सुपरलेटिव विशेषण से पहले 'most' का उपयोग करना 'double superlative' की गलती है। सही वाक्य केवल "This is the tallest building..." होना चाहिए।

Short Trick:
Don't use 'most' with adjectives ending in '-est'.

q_en:
Select the most appropriate article to fill in the blank. If no article is needed, select 'No article required'.

They crossed ______ Pacific Ocean during their voyage.
q_hi:
Select the most appropriate article to fill in the blank. If no article is needed, select 'No article required'.

They crossed ______ Pacific Ocean during their voyage.
solution:
Solution (EN):
The definite article 'the' is always used before the names of oceans, seas, mountain ranges, and rivers. Thus, 'the Pacific Ocean' is correct.

Solution (HI):
निश्चित उपपद 'the' का प्रयोग हमेशा महासागरों, समुद्रों, पर्वत श्रृंखलाओं और नदियों के नाम के पहले किया जाता है। इसलिए, 'the Pacific Ocean' सही है।

Short Trick:
Names of Oceans → Always use 'The'.

q_en:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

He completed the assignment _______ than his classmates.
q_hi:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

He completed the assignment _______ than his classmates.
solution:
Solution (EN):
The sentence involves a comparison between 'He' and 'his classmates', signaled by the word 'than'. For such comparisons using adverbs ending in '-ly', we use the comparative form 'more + adverb'.

Solution (HI):
वाक्य में 'He' और 'his classmates' के बीच तुलना की गई है, जिसे 'than' शब्द द्वारा दर्शाया गया है। '-ly' में समाप्त होने वाले क्रियाविशेषणों (adverbs) के लिए तुलनात्मक रूप 'more + adverb' का उपयोग किया जाता है।

Short Trick:
Than → Comparative degree (More + Adverb).

q_en:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The kitten is very _______ and plays all day long.
q_hi:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The kitten is very _______ and plays all day long.
solution:
Solution (EN):
The context of "plays all day long" suggests a positive and high-energy state. 'Cheerful' (happy and optimistic) fits best. 'Lethargic' (lazy) is the opposite. 'Actively' is an adverb, while the sentence requires an adjective to describe the kitten.

Solution (HI):
"Plays all day long" (पूरे दिन खेलता है) का संदर्भ एक सकारात्मक और ऊर्जावान स्थिति का सुझाव देता है। 'Cheerful' (हंसमुख/खुशमिजाज) यहाँ सबसे उपयुक्त है। 'Lethargic' का अर्थ सुस्त होता है।

Short Trick:
Kitten + Play all day → Happy/Energetic → Cheerful.

q_en:
Select the appropriate one-word substitute for the highlighted part.

The committee dissolved because no one could tolerate a society organised around female dominance in family and social structures.
q_hi:
Select the appropriate one-word substitute for the highlighted part.

The committee dissolved because no one could tolerate a society organised around female dominance in family and social structures.
solution:
Solution (EN):
A society or system of government ruled by a woman or women is called a 'matriarchy'.
1. Monarchy: Rule by a king or queen.
2. Oligarchy: Rule by a small group of people.
3. Patriarchy: Rule by men.

Solution (HI):
महिलाओं द्वारा शासित समाज या शासन प्रणाली को 'matriarchy' (मातृसत्ता) कहा जाता है।
1. Monarchy: राजा या रानी का शासन।
2. Oligarchy: कुछ चुनिंदा लोगों का शासन।
3. Patriarchy: पितृसत्ता (पुरुषों का शासन)।

Short Trick:
Matri (Mother/Female) + Archy (Rule).

q_en:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the highlighted phrase in the given sentence.

q_hi:

Despite her efforts, she was accused of the murder of her own brother, a crime that shocked everyone in the village.
solution:
Solution (EN):
'Fratricide' is the act of killing one's own brother or sister.
1. Parricide: The killing of a parent or other near relative.
2. Regicide: The killing of a king.
3. Homicide: The killing of one person by another (general).

Solution (HI):
'Fratricide' (भ्रातृवध) अपने ही भाई या बहन की हत्या करने का कृत्य है।
1. Parricide: माता-पिता या किसी अन्य करीबी रिश्तेदार की हत्या।
2. Regicide: राजा की हत्या।
3. Homicide: मानव वध (सामान्य)।

Frater (Brother) + Cide (Kill).

op_en: Of the two players, Rohit is the skillful.
Of the two players, Rohit is more skillfuller.
Of the two players, Rohit is more skillful.
Of the two players, Rohit is much skillful.
op_hi: Of the two players, Rohit is the skillful.
Of the two players, Rohit is more skillfuller.
Of the two players, Rohit is more skillful.
Of the two players, Rohit is much skillful.
q_en:
Identify the option that rectifies the given sentence to make it grammatically correct.

Of the two players, Rohit is the most skillful.
q_hi:
Identify the option that rectifies the given sentence to make it grammatically correct.

Of the two players, Rohit is the most skillful.
solution:
Solution (EN):
When comparing exactly two items or people, the comparative degree is used. The superlative degree ('most') is reserved for comparing three or more. Thus, "more skillful" is the correct form.

Solution (HI):
जब ठीक दो वस्तुओं या व्यक्तियों की तुलना की जाती है, तो तुलनात्मक डिग्री (comparative degree) का उपयोग किया जाता है। सुपरलेटिव डिग्री ('most') का उपयोग तीन या अधिक की तुलना के लिए किया जाता है। अतः "more skillful" सही रूप है।

Short Trick:
Two people → Comparative degree (More).

q_hi: Select the grammatically correct sentence.

q_en:
Select the most appropriate article to fill in the blank. If no article is needed, select 'No article required'.

_______ Himalayas are the highest mountain range in the world.
q_hi:
Select the most appropriate article to fill in the blank. If no article is needed, select 'No article required'.

_______ Himalayas are the highest mountain range in the world.
solution:
Solution (EN):
The definite article 'the' is used before the names of mountain ranges (e.g., the Alps, the Himalayas). However, it is not used before the names of single mountain peaks (e.g., Mount Everest).

Solution (HI):
निश्चित उपपद 'the' का प्रयोग पर्वत श्रृंखलाओं (जैसे, the Himalayas) के नाम के पहले किया जाता है। एकल पर्वत चोटियों (जैसे, Mount Everest) के पहले इसका प्रयोग नहीं किया जाता।

Short Trick:
Mountain Range → The.

q_en:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below. While the first and the last sentences (S1 and S6) are in the correct order, the sentences in between are jumbled up. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

S1) Climate change has emerged as one of the biggest challenges facing humanity.
A) This has led to erratic weather patterns, rising sea levels, and loss of biodiversity.
B) Scientists across the globe are working tirelessly to find sustainable solutions.
C) Human activities like deforestation and excessive use of fossil fuels are the main culprits.
D) Governments are also being urged to implement stricter environmental policies.
S6) Only collective and timely action can help mitigate the effects of this global crisis.
q_hi:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below. While the first and the last sentences (S1 and S6) are in the correct order, the sentences in between are jumbled up. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

S1) Climate change has emerged as one of the biggest challenges facing humanity.
A) This has led to erratic weather patterns, rising sea levels, and loss of biodiversity.
B) Scientists across the globe are working tirelessly to find sustainable solutions.
C) Human activities like deforestation and excessive use of fossil fuels are the main culprits.
D) Governments are also being urged to implement stricter environmental policies.
S6) Only collective and timely action can help mitigate the effects of this global crisis.
solution:
Solution (EN):
S1 starts the topic. 'C' points out the causes of climate change. 'A' describes the effects of those causes. 'B' and 'D' list the efforts being made by experts and authorities to solve the problem. S6 concludes with the need for action. Correct sequence: CABD.

Solution (HI):
S1 विषय की शुरुआत करता है। 'C' जलवायु परिवर्तन के कारणों की ओर इशारा करता है। 'A' उन कारणों के प्रभावों का वर्णन करता है। 'B' और 'D' समस्या को हल करने के प्रयासों की सूची देते हैं। S6 निष्कर्ष निकालता है। सही क्रम: CABD है।

Short Trick:
Cause (C) → Effect (A). This link confirms the sequence.

q_en:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

1. Despite these complexities, avocados remain superfoods rich in healthy fats and potassium.
2. This unique quality is because it does not ripen until picked from the tree.
3. Consequently, the fruit must be harvested carefully for transportation.
4. The avocado, botanically a single-seeded berry, is unlike most fruits.
q_hi:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

1. Despite these complexities, avocados remain superfoods rich in healthy fats and potassium.
2. This unique quality is because it does not ripen until picked from the tree.
3. Consequently, the fruit must be harvested carefully for transportation.
4. The avocado, botanically a single-seeded berry, is unlike most fruits.
solution:
Solution (EN):
Sentence 4 introduces the avocado as an unusual fruit. Sentence 2 follows by explaining the 'unique quality' mentioned or implied in 4 (ripening only after picking). Sentence 3 explains the consequence ('Consequently') of that ripening process. Sentence 1 concludes with a positive summary despite the complexities.

Solution (HI):
वाक्य 4 एवोकैडो को एक असामान्य फल के रूप में पेश करता है। वाक्य 2 उस 'विशिष्ट गुणवत्ता' की व्याख्या करता है जिसका उल्लेख 4 में किया गया है। वाक्य 3 पकने की उस प्रक्रिया के परिणाम ('Consequently') की व्याख्या करता है। वाक्य 1 सकारात्मक सारांश के साथ समाप्त होता है।

Short Trick:
4 is the introductory sentence. Only option 4231 and 4321 start with it. 'Consequently' (3) follows the cause in 2.
